_doc: The sound pack (0.8, completed in 0.9: nothing the game plays is synthesised any more). Every file in assets/audio/pack (the creator's 'sound effects to add' folder, 298 files, and the CC0 recordings found online that are listed under 'credits') is named here against the sound it is. 'sounds': game sound -> its takes (the first is the sound, the rest are chosen between at random, never the same twice running); a take may be {'file', 'start', 'length'} to use part of a recording; the object form adds a peak 'level' (default 0.85, 0.6 for ui_/inv_) a 'lowpass' in Hz applied at load, and 'loop': true for a sound that is played round and round (it is joined to itself). 'streams': long beds decoded when first needed. 'weapons': close recordings of each firearm, laid over its layered set by the gun bus (see weapon_audio.json 'punch'). File names are without extension and case-insensitive; .wav, .ogg and .mp3 are all read. tools/SelfTests08 (audio08) fails if a file in the pack is unused, missing or unreadable.
